newsModeration.none: No news item waits or is reported.
newsModeration.pick: Pick an item of the queue to read it.

holdReasons.sourceModeration: Its newspaper is reviewed before publication
holdReasons.aiApproval: CMarket AI's items wait for approval
holdReasons.lowConfidence: CMarket AI is less sure than the threshold

newsModeration.noBody: A story of the feeds: its headline, its summary and the link to the original article.
newsModeration.approveMessage: It goes live now, or at the time its newspaper chose; its news alerts follow.
newsModeration.keepMessage: It stays online and its reports are closed.
newsModeration.takeDownMessage: It leaves the feed, or never reaches it, and stops collecting clicks. Its newspaper reads your reason in its studio.
newsModeration.toFlashMessage: A FLASH keeps its text only: the body and the PDF go. It is not pushed again.
newsModeration.toArticleMessage: Its text becomes the body, its first 400 characters the standfirst.
newsModeration.approvedScheduled: Approved: it goes live at its time.
newsModeration.takenDown: Taken down: the item left the feed.

newsReport.title: Report this item
newsReport.intro: CMarket's moderators read your report; the newspaper does not learn who sent it.

publishers.hint: The newspaper of a story of the international API or of CMarket AI, by the domain of its link. A domain without a row shows its own name.
publishers.domainHint: mediaexample.com, or a link of the site.
publishers.name: Name
publishers.shortNameHint: Upper case, 16 characters at most; the name in capitals when empty.
publishers.removeMessage: Its newspapers keep the names they have; the next stories of the domain are named after it again.
publishers.saved: Saved: the newspapers of {{domain}} take its names.

newsSources.pick: Pick a newspaper to see its contract and its providers.
newsSources.name: Name
newsSources.shortNameHint: Upper case, 16 characters at most: the tag of its items.
newsSources.moderationHint: After: its items go live at once and a moderator may take them down. Before: each waits in NEWS and MOD.
newsSources.noMembers: No News provider publishes for it yet.
newsSources.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 512 KB at most: shown on the card of its tag.

errors.name: 1 to 100 characters.
errors.rate: An amount of XAF, 0 or more.

newsSettings.thresholdHint: From 0.00 to 1.00: an item CMarket AI is less sure of waits for a moderator, whatever the mode.
newsSettings.viewsPerHourHint: Past it, an account's next views count as automated access and are not paid.

ingestClients.hint: The servers of CMarket AI that push news (POST /api/v1/ingest/news): their key, the HMAC-SHA256 signature of each body, their addresses.
ingestClients.name: Name
ingestClients.addressesHint: One a line: an address (203.0.113.7) or a CIDR range (203.0.113.0/24); 20 at most.
ingestClients.revokeMessage: Its next calls are refused. Its items stay in the feed.
ingestClients.secretIntro: Give the client its key and its secret. The secret shows this once: CMarket keeps it sealed and never shows it again.

errors.name: 1 to 100 characters.
errors.address: {{address}} is not an address or a CIDR range.
